heroHeadline: Day 974: 25 Days to Supreme Court July 1 October 7 Accountability Deadline — Habima Protest Demands Probe; Hamas Qassam Brigades Without Commander for 11th Day
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. June 7, 2026 (Day 974 / Ceasefire Day 241): Israel's October 7 accountability crisis has deepened to its most acute level with 25 days to the Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 constitutional deadline. On June 6, approximately 1,000 people rallied at Habima Square in Tel Aviv — the sister of a slain Gaza hostage accused the government of trying to 'erase the massacre, the abandonment, and its responsibility' and of preventing a genuine investigation. A central protest grievance was Netanyahu's appointment of his personal defense attorney, Michael Rabello, as state comptroller — the official legally mandated to audit government conduct before, during, and after October 7. Police investigation confirmed the June 3 Haredi attack on Supreme Court Deputy President Sohlberg's home was organized in advance with buses transporting rioters with coordinated intent to harm the judge; protests shifted to the Russian Compound police station on June 6. Former Supreme Court President Beinisch (June 5) warned Israel was 'sliding toward anarchy.' The coalition's Kallner inquiry bill remains three plenum readings from passage — stripped of independence language, barring judges, requiring 80 Knesset members for each commission seat — virtually guaranteeing Supreme Court invalidation if passed. As of Day 974: Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades remain without a publicly named supreme commander for the 11th consecutive day following the IDF killing of Mohammed Odeh (May 27) — a duration exceeding Odeh's entire 9-day tenure. Imad Aqel remains the last surviving senior Hamas figure from the October 7 planning circle and the NILI task force's primary target. No new NILI strike reported June 6-7. June 3 (Day 970): IDF Chief Zamir declared 'no ceasefire for our forces' in Lebanon; Board of Peace reconstruction 'stalled.' June 2 (Day 969): Abu Obeida vowed 'assassinations will never break resistance.' All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026. October 7 Perpetrators Eliminated: Sinwar (Oct 16, 2024), Shambari (Apr 29, 2026), Haddad (May 16, 2026), Odeh (May 27, 2026). Last survivor: Imad Aqel. Accountability: Kallner bill stalled; 25 days to July 1 deadline; Beyachad pledges Day-1 state commission; early elections looming.
